🧪 ColorSort

Tubes contain mixed colored balls — you must sort them so each tube contains balls of only one color. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Click a tube to select it, then click another tube to pour.
  2. Only the top ball of the selected tube transfers.
  3. Pour onto a tube with the same top color, or into an empty tube.
  4. Sort all balls so each tube has only one color.
  5. Plan pours carefully — pouring into the wrong tube creates new mixes.
